subject: Partnership: co-sell pilot for embeddings storage with Pinecone
messages:
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@pinecone.io>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@pinecone.io
Date: 2026-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership: co-sell pilot for embeddings storage with Pinecone

Hi Dev,

Hope you’re well — I’m on the Redwood partner team at Pinecone. We’ve been tracking a few mutual customers who are standardizing on Redwood for serving and Pinecone for vector storage, and there’s demand to simplify a co-sell/pilot flow.

High level ask: would Redwood be open to a short pilot (6–8 weeks) that bundles Pinecone storage configuration + a lightweight mutual action plan so our joint reps can accelerate POCs? We’d cover an initial credit amount for the storage footprint and provide a joint tech onboarding session.

Would love to schedule a 30-minute sync next week to sketch a MAP and agree on technical touchpoints (prefix caching, namespace strategy, backup/snapshot cadence).

Thanks,
Taylor Nguyen
Partner Manager, Pinecone
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@pinecone.io>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: co-sell pilot for embeddings storage with Pinecone

Thanks Taylor — great timing. We’ve seen similar asks from a couple of fintech customers who want predictable cost and simplified persisting of KV/prefix caches into Pinecone.

I’m looping in Marissa (partnerships) and Sergio (sales lead) to coordinate the MAP and commercial terms. Proposed next steps:
- 30-min sync: technical + GTM owners (we can do Wed or Thu next week)
- Draft MAP with milestones and success criteria (tech + commercial)
- Security checkpoint: quick SOC2 snapshot and minimal data flow diagram

Marissa — can you take the lead on the MAP doc and attach the template? Sergio — can you flag any deal/territory constraints we should be aware of?

Dev Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor@pinecone.io>
Date: 2026-08-15T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Partnership: co-sell pilot for embeddings storage with Pinecone

Adding the MAP draft and a SOC2 snapshot for your security team to review. I kept the scope narrow for the pilot: 6 weeks, one joint customer, a shared success metric (90th percentile end-to-end inference latency under X ms), and a rollback plan.

Attachments: RBW-Pinecone-MAP-v1.docx (draft MAP), SOC2_snapshot.pdf (high-level evidence)

Call windows: Tue 8/18 9am PT or Wed 8/19 11am PT — Taylor, which works best for you?

Marissa Cole
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Redwood Inference
From: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@pinecone.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-15T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Partnership: co-sell pilot for embeddings storage with Pinecone

Marissa — thanks for the draft. Wed 8/19 11am PT works for us.

I’ve uploaded a pricing and territory file and started a DocuSign MSA powerform so legal can expedite the small pilot terms. Link below.

Attachments: pinecone-pricing-territory.xlsx
DocuSign (MSA) link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=abc123

Taylor
Partner Manager, Pinecone

On Fri, Aug 14, 2026 at 9:12 AM Taylor Nguyen <taylor@pinecone.io> wrote:
> Hope you’re well — I’m on the Redwood partner team at Pinecone...
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Taylor Nguyen <taylor@pinecone.io>
Date: 2026-08-17T16:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Partnership: co-sell pilot for embeddings storage with Pinecone

Looping back after a quick sync with our regional reps — a couple commercial notes:
- We should keep the pilot customer list to mutual accounts where both reps have existing relationships.
- Need to confirm which side covers incremental S3 snapshot costs for persistence backups (we prefer Pinecone to cover experimental storage credits).
- Co-marketing: I want to run a joint case study template by legal before publishing.

Taylor — can you confirm the DocuSign timeline? Also tagging Marissa for MAP finalization.

Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Taylor Nguyen <taylor@pinecone.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-20T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Partnership: co-sell pilot for embeddings storage with Pinecone — next steps

Thanks team — quick summary / agreed actions:
1) MAP: Marissa to finalize RBW-Pinecone-MAP-v1.docx by 2026-08-21 and circulate for sign-off.
2) Legal/commercial: Taylor to push DocuSign MSA; target signature by 2026-08-25.
3) Pilot scope: one mutual account (TBD) and 6-week run starting no earlier than 2026-09-01.
4) Security: Redwood will circulate a short data flow diagram (Dev) and Pinecone will confirm snapshot/backup responsibilities (Taylor).
5) Co-marketing: Sergio to draft case study brief; Marissa to route to legal.

Marissa — please attach the final MAP and the minimal SOW stub (one pager) in the repo. Taylor — if you can confirm the DocuSign powerform id and whether Pinecone will cover the first-month snapshot credits, we’ll be set.

Action owners copied.

Dev Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships, Redwood Inference
